item.subject: science
item.stem:
On a hot afternoon in Jaipur, Ravi opens a window of his classroom. The air pressure inside the room is higher than the air pressure outside, and the two regions are connected through the open window.
Which statement about the air flow is correct?

options.A: Air flows from outside into the room because air moves from lower pressure to higher pressure.
options.B: Air flows from the room to the outside, and it flows faster when the pressure difference is larger.
options.C: Air does not flow at all because the pressure difference keeps the air at rest.
options.D: Air flows from outside into the room, and a larger pressure difference makes the flow slower.
